headline: The universe of Money Heist expands now onto paper, Netlix
content: Netflix launches books of its original series An important alliance have materialized between Netflix and publisher Planeta. Yesterday, the platform confirmed it would launch books based on some of their successful original series such as Money Heist and Casa De Flores. At present, we dont know the authors’ names but what’s known is that scriptwriters of these successful productions in Spain will participate. It should be noted that these titles won’t reproduce what was seen on screen, rather new plots and characters will be created. The Vice President of Netflix, Francisco Ramos told AFP that it is very interesting and powerful agreement which allows stories about those characters to go around the world achieving synergy among themselves. The titles are expected towards year-end.

headline: James Cameron greets new record of Endgame
content: Hello Ngati Kameie, Marvel! wrote director of Avatar dedicating a tweet to the movie most box office success ever achieved surpassing his own film Avatar (2009). Yesterday, filmmaker James Cameron congratulated Avengers: Endgame becoming the highest-grossing movie of all time beating out his film Avatar ($2.788 million worldwide gross) Congratulations to Avengers: Endgame being the new king of the box-office, he tweeted whose films Avatar and Titanic occupy second and third place respectively in historical list. Meanwhile directors of Avengers: Endgame brothers Anthony and Joseph Russo returned the compliment through Twitter saying that there were monumental reasons why they fell in love with cinema. Thank you always inspiring us and opening people eyes to possibilities. We’re looking forward where next takes us. said Russo Brothers.
